browserRuntimeLimit.detail: The local Astro preview embeds resource previews in opaque sandboxed iframes. Its preview host returns a localhost-specific Access-Control-Allow-Origin value, causing local iframe module CORS/hydration errors in the separate local screenshot harness. The deployed Site v16 had zero Explore console, failed-request, and HTTP errors. Do not treat the local harness failure as a deployed product failure; repeat runtime diagnostics against the next Sites version.
